records.title: No AI-specific incident response and escalation procedure
records.rationale: No completed AI incident playbook is evidenced; existing security processes do not show model-output incident classification, AI escalation paths or lessons learned.

records.title: No documented human review and override for consequential outputs
records.rationale: No documented human review or override gate before outputs are used in consequential document review or regulatory filing workflows.

records.title: Incomplete model transparency documentation
records.rationale: Purpose is known, but a complete model card, limitations statement and fine-tuning data characteristics have not been provided.

records.title: No qualified human review or safe override before diagnostic decisions
records.rationale: Policy 9.1 governs production change but does not require review of AI diagnostic outputs; a direct patient-safety gap.

records.title: No AI incident plan for biased, unsafe or incorrect outputs
records.rationale: Policy 8.2 covers data security incidents only; AI output harms lack roles, escalation, records and recurrence prevention.

records.title: No lifecycle documentation of purpose, capabilities and limitations
records.rationale: Change control captures change, reason and rollback only; no persistent AI documentation or stakeholder access is required.
